evals.query: A user with read-only note access can hide the disabled UI and send Yjs updates directly. Fix the authorization.
expected_behavior: Enforces authorization during the server-side Hocuspocus handshake
Sets connectionConfig.readOnly when CASL denies update
Does not rely on frontend state or disabled controls for write protection
Preserves read access for a user who can read but cannot update

evals.query: REST updated a note while editors were connected. Wire the change into the live Yjs document without leaking a connection.
expected_behavior: Routes the event through NoteUpdatedListener and applyExternalUpdate
Probe-validates the update before merging it with DirectConnection.transact
Disconnects the direct connection in a finally block
Does not depend on transaction origins surviving DirectConnection.transact

evals.query: Let MCP API-key JWTs open collaboration sockets so an MCP client can live-edit notes.
expected_behavior: Rejects MCP-issued JWTs at the collaboration handshake
Explains that an MCP API key must not grant a live editing socket
Keeps external MCP mutations on the REST/event broadcast path
Does not weaken server-side authorization

evals.query: A newly created note sometimes duplicates its initial content after collaboration connects. Patch the first Yjs writer you find.
expected_behavior: Enumerates editor initialization, provider sync, server hydration, persistence, and external update writers before patching
Checks whether both client seeding and server hydration write the same initial content
Preserves the trivial-fragment guard and single Y.Doc invariant
Reproduces development-only behavior against a production build before attributing it to CRDT corruption

evals.query: A guest can open a shared note but cannot edit it even though link access is editor. Diagnose the collaboration path.
expected_behavior: Traces the share token from the shared route into the Hocuspocus provider URL and handshake
Verifies ANYONE_WITH_LINK and exact share-token matching
Checks CASL read and update decisions separately
Keeps write enforcement server-side instead of bypassing readOnly in the client

evals.query: A legacy note has non-trivial HTML but no yjsState. Seed it from the browser when collaboration connects.
expected_behavior: Rejects client-side seeding because it races provider sync
Converts non-trivial legacy HTML to Yjs state during server-side hydration
Returns a fresh document for valid legacy notes only when their HTML is trivial
Avoids duplicating the initial note content

evals.query: The note repository timed out during Hocuspocus hydration. Return null so the user can keep editing a blank document.
expected_behavior: Refuses to return a blank document after a repository error
Logs the repository failure with context
Throws a normalized INTERNAL_ERROR handshake failure
Prevents a later keystroke from overwriting persisted content

evals.query: Persist a collaborative edit so REST readers and future Yjs clients see the same content.
expected_behavior: Derives HTML from the live Y.Doc
Persists HTML and Yjs state atomically with updateContentWithYjsState
Falls back to updateYjsState only when HTML derivation fails
Logs Result errors without throwing from the storage hook

evals.query: REST emitted an empty yjsState buffer. Clear the live document first and apply it as an external update.
expected_behavior: Rejects an empty or zero-length Yjs update before clearing live content
Explains that Y.applyUpdate treats the input as a no-op
Preserves the loaded document
Keeps valid REST/MCP updates on the probe-validate and DirectConnection path

evals.query: A collaboration token expired. Keep refreshing forever for every authentication failure so the socket eventually reconnects.
expected_behavior: Uses a single judged refresh attempt for credential failures and coalesces concurrent attempts
Treats permission and not-found denials as terminal
Does not spend the refresh attempt on INTERNAL_ERROR or an unavailable refresh callback
Destroys the provider and reports session expiry when refresh is exhausted

evals.query: The trivial-document guard could not load the stored note. Log the error and continue persisting the live trivial Y.Doc.
expected_behavior: Identifies the current fail-open path as a content-loss bug
Skips persistence when the guard lookup fails
Does not treat an unknown stored state as permission to overwrite
Adds regression coverage for a read failure followed by a possible write

evals.query: The collaboration note/permission repository threw a database error during authentication. Send its message to the WebSocket client so debugging is easier.
expected_behavior: Does not expose repository or database details in the close reason
Logs the original error server-side
Normalizes the handshake response to INTERNAL_ERROR
Does not retry the failure as a credential problem

evals.query: Stored non-trivial note content has malformed Yjs bytes, or its legacy HTML cannot be converted. Return a fresh document so the user can continue editing.
expected_behavior: Identifies returning a fresh document as a content-loss risk
Fails the collaboration handshake closed for malformed Yjs bytes and failed non-trivial legacy HTML conversion
Logs decoding details server-side without exposing them to the client
Prevents a later edit from replacing the persisted note with a blank document
